purpose: Materialize public historical Polymarket observability for the deterministic semantic evidence queue without using Gamma start/end dates or current lifetime volume as substitutes for point-in-time market evidence.

source_contract.gamma_event: GET https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/events/{event_id}; identifier resolution only: nested market IDs, conditionId, clobTokenIds, enableOrderBook, acceptingOrdersTimestamp and resolutionSource metadata.
source_contract.data_trades: GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/trades?eventId={event_id}&limit=10000&offset=0&takerOnly=false; public timestamped trade evidence. If exactly 10000 rows are returned, history is flagged truncated and the observed minimum is not claimed to be the true first trade.
source_contract.clob_prices_history: GET https://clob.polymarket.com/prices-history?market={token_id}&interval=max; public timestamped historical price observations per CLOB token.
source_contract.authentication: None for Gamma, Data API, or CLOB public market-data endpoints used here.
source_contract.rate_policy: Sequential requests; >=0.05 seconds between requests; exponential retry on 429/5xx/network errors; maximum 5 attempts.

timestamp_semantics.gamma_accepting_orders_timestamp: Historical platform metadata evidence that the market was configured to accept orders; stored separately because current Gamma metadata may have been edited after close.
timestamp_semantics.trade_observation_timestamp: Minimum timestamp among public Data API trade rows returned for the event. If trade history is truncated, it is an observed lower-bound witness only, not the true first trade.
timestamp_semantics.price_observation_timestamp: Minimum timestamp returned by CLOB price history across all nested market tokens; this proves a historical price observation, not necessarily the first trade.
timestamp_semantics.platform_earliest_evidence: Minimum non-null timestamp across accepting-orders metadata, observed public trades, and CLOB price history. It is evidence of platform observability only.

event_pit_a_status.PASS_PLATFORM_HISTORY_OBSERVED: At least one timestamped public trade or CLOB historical price observation exists. acceptingOrdersTimestamp alone is supportive metadata but cannot create PASS.
event_pit_a_status.METADATA_ONLY_UNRESOLVED: Only Gamma activation metadata is available; no timestamped trade/price observation was recovered.
event_pit_a_status.NO_PLATFORM_HISTORY_RECOVERED: No timestamped historical market observation and no activation metadata recovered.
event_pit_a_status.NETWORK_UNRESOLVED: Required requests did not complete after frozen retries; never convert a network failure to absence.

family_summary.reason: F1/F2/F7 require a separately materialized official public-revelation timestamp and safe-cutoff layer. F1-F9 are not scored in PIT-A.

prohibitions: No ARGOS PnL/Brier/log loss/H2/economic performance reads.
No use of Gamma startDate/endDate as proof of first trade, market presence before news, or safe cutoff.
No use of current/lifetime volume or liquidity as PIT liquidity.
No F1-F9, IAS, robust ranking, or W3 selection in this stage.
No dropping a family because PIT-A coverage looks inconvenient; missing network evidence remains unresolved.
next_boundary: After PIT-A materialization, preregister PIT-B for primary-source revelation/resolution timestamps and preoutcome linked-asset mapping before scoring F1-F9.
